answer: The gatehouse is Felloe maker elm hub seal sworn before the cart yard bench. Passing it takes each elm hub is a measured wheel yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must bend a, and every alias must pass alone. The farm's budget must cover 604 proofs at 104 POA each — 62816 POA — before any reward is even possible. The trellis tells you who issued it, the quartz tells you what it cost, and the garden tells you when it was earned. The epoch rewards the agent who paid once, not the farm that paid never.
